thread:
oncall-bot: Paging @maria (SRE), p99 for streaming responses > 30s observed for multiple customers in us-west-2, SLO breach triggered :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Incident severity: P1 — automatic paging to oncall@sre.redwood.com

oncall-bot: Affected services: streaming-proxy-usw2, streaming-gateway, websocket-ingest, model-tail-handler

maria (SRE): popping in — seeing p95 ~ 2.3s but p99 spiking to 32-45s for tail chunks. Many of these are 'no progress' stalls (socket open but no chunk delivered).

kevin (Platform): noticed a spike in socket write queue depth on proxy pods and increased 502s from the edge. Could be client slow consumers + proxy write buffer growth.

oliver (Infra): I'm on the proxy metrics — write_latency_ms p99 jumped at 09:12 UTC alongside an increase in active connections from a large customer. No infra autoscale triggered — HPA threshold not hit.

maria (SRE): key question — is this upstream model runtime stalling or proxy-level blocking/backpressure? Can someone run a quick trace on a sample request id from logs?

kevin (Platform): grabbing a sample. From logs: request_id=abcd-1234, connection=socket-499, backend_model=redwood-13b-quant. Last backend token emitted at 09:11:52, then proxy did not push any more chunks until 09:12:24. Proxy logs show repeated EAGAIN on write.

oliver (Infra): that matches client backpressure on the downstream socket — the kernel send buffer filled and the proxy paused. There are also a few timeouts in the proxy: "write timeout after 20s" in the past hour.

sara (Support): a small number of customers reported hung responses in the last 20 minutes. Customer-facing note: some streaming responses stalled and recovered; some clients had to reconnect. No persisted data loss.

maria (SRE): immediate mitigation options — 1) increase proxy write timeout and lower internal keepalive interval to detect dead peers; 2) enable chunk flush policy on the gateway (force periodic flush smaller chunks); 3) route traffic away from proxy nodes with highest socket queue to a fresh pool; 4) apply temporary client-side guidance (shorter read buffer expectations). I'll coordinate live.

oliver (Infra): I can spin up 4 extra proxy pods and taint the old saturated pods for draining. Command: 
```bash
kubectl scale deployment/streaming-proxy-usw2 --replicas=12 -n prod
kubectl cordon pod/proxy-old-42 -n prod
```
I'll also bump node group by 2 for capacity.

kevin (Platform): I'll add a routing rule to prefer proxy pods with low tcp_write_queue via our loadbalancer. Quick patch: set header-based routing "X-proxy-load" and LB weights.

maria (SRE): While infra works scaling, enable forced flush. ops-bridge-bot, can you push the gateway config change? Need chunk_flush_interval: 150ms and max_chunk_size: 16kb for 30m window.

ops-bridge-bot: Gateway config change queued. Will apply to us-west-2 canary now and roll to rest if green.

ops-bridge-bot: Canary applied to streaming-gateway-usw2-canary: chunk_flush_interval=150ms, max_chunk_size=16KB

kevin (Platform): Canary metrics look promising — canary p99 write latency down from 41s -> 9.2s on similar load within 2 minutes.

maria (SRE): Good. Rolling to primary now but do a conservative 2m stall-check between pods. Also, reduce proxy write timeout from 20s -> 12s to fail fast on clearly blocked connections.

oliver (Infra): Proxy pods scaled up and drain started on top-3 saturated pods. Node group +2 provisioning in progress.

sara (Support): Drafting a short customer note: "We're mitigating intermittent streaming stalls that affected a subset of customers in us-west-2. We applied routing and gateway flush changes; customers may see brief reconnects. We're monitoring and will follow up." Want review?

maria (SRE): Looks fine. Add: "no data loss; if you see persistent hanged streams, please reconnect and attach X-Request-Id."

kevin (Platform): Observability note — add a new graph to incident dashboard: socket_send_q_len p95/p99 per-proxy, plus proxy_write_retries. Hunt for patterns by client IP block.

maria (SRE): Running a quick correlation: clients showing stalls are clustered to a few CIDR blocks — looks like slower mobile proxies and older SDK versions that don't consume quickly. We should consider a short-term mitigation: per-client rate limiter that drops long-pause streams after 10s with a retry header.

oliver (Infra): Implemented LB weight change, can confirm traffic shifted ~38% to new pods. p99 latency decreased to ~7-12s. Some long tails still persist for older SDKs.

maria (SRE): Next steps (short):
- Keep gateway flush policy for 30m and monitor
- Keep scaled proxy fleet for 45m, then evaluate
- Set proxy write timeout to 12s and add connection drop metric alerts
- Create follow-up to add per-client slow-consumer backpressure mitigation in 2-week sprint

sara (Support): Sending updated customer note now. Will paste copy once posted.

ops-bridge-bot: Rollout complete: streaming-gateway-usw2 rolled to 6 pods with new chunking config. No immediate rollback signs.

maria (SRE): Incident status: mitigation in place, p99 trending down from 40s->9s, partial recovery. Still monitoring for residuals. Assigning to oliver for remediation and kevin for follow-up platform changes. I'll stay on until primary oncall returns. Handoff planned at 09:45 UTC.

oliver (Infra): I'll open a remediation ticket: PROXY-4567 "slow-consumer pressure handling: add send-side backpressure prioritization & fail-fast connection drop" and link traces + sample request ids.

kevin (Platform): I'll add routing automation: auto-scale proxy pool on tcp_write_queue > threshold and LB negative-weight pods > 30%. Ticket PLATFORM-3322.

maria (SRE): Customer impact assessment: ~0.8% of streaming requests in us-west-2 experienced stalls > 10s, ~0.12% hit > 30s. Affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants reported degraded UX, 12 small clients saw brief waits. No error-level data loss.

sara (Support): Sent update to customers and opened support cases for the three enterprise tenants; engineers will attach diagnostics.

maria (SRE): Handoff to oliver and kevin at 09:45 UTC. I'll be on-call loop for 30m after for escalation. If anything regresses, re-page SRE oncall. :thumbsup:

ops-bridge-bot: Handoff recorded. next_oncall=oliver (Infra). incident_state=mitigated.monitoring

oliver (Infra): Taking over. I'll follow up with a post-incident writeup including timeline, root cause hypothesis (downstream slow consumers + insufficient proxy fail-fast + chunk buffering config), and long-term remediation plan.

kevin (Platform): Copy — I'll attach load test results for the proposed rate limiter and LB autoscale params.

maria (SRE): Thanks all. Closing pager loop.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved? No — state=mitigated.monitoring until we confirm 60m of stable p99 < 10s.

end of thread
